svg.desc: ICity International School LOCATION 6th of October City, Egypt CLIENT Egypt Learning Group (ELG) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2021 280 million EGP DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Interior Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Environmental Design Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2021, this private school in 6th of October City spans 10 feddans and was designed for Egypt Learning Group. BECT delivered architecture, landscape and interior design, environmental, structural and MEP services, together with project management and site supervision, to create a high-quality educational environment for students.
